project.name: MK7-Native
project.title: Mario Kart 7 Native
project.tagline: Clean-room native PC runtime for user-supplied Mario Kart 7 data
project.platform: Nintendo 3DS / ARM11 / PICA200 to Windows / Vulkan
project.compiler: C++23 or newer through CMake and Ninja
project.setup: Initialize the pinned submodules, configure the default CMake preset, and build it. Supply legally dumped game data only as external paths.
project.rules: Never commit ROMs, extracted assets, keys, generated game code, frame captures, or other copyrighted game data. Clean-room implementation uses public hardware documentation and locally supplied dumps.
project.submitting: Run the default test preset and the focused PICA tests. Real-ROM findings must be recorded as metadata or reproducible behavior, never copied game content.
project.knownWalls: A draw count is not a visual milestone. Require a completed guest framebuffer, nonzero changed pixels, a non-diagnostic capture, matching presented checksum, and an input-driven frame change. Unknown indirect branches fail closed.
project.nearMissNote: Record unsupported instructions, shader opcodes, PICA registers, and rejected draw reasons explicitly instead of adding compatibility approximations.

requirements.compiler: CMake 3.25+, Ninja, Vulkan SDK, and a C++23-capable compiler
requirements.notes: ctrtool is needed for a real-ROM run. The CIA and optional shared-data RomFS/CIA remain outside this repository. tangOS is an optional project console and is not linked into MK7-Native.

tools.docs: The ROM is read from its original path and is never copied into the repository. Omit headless_slices to open the Vulkan window; provide it for a bounded headless acceptance run.
